## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.  
Apply the twelve-character minimum to invite passwords before merge because that path still accepts passwords below the stated security minimum.

## Changes

The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimums from eight to twelve characters and updates both boundary tests.

## Critical

- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Enforce the twelve-character minimum on invite passwords — An eleven-character password still passes the invite validator at `app/invite.py:1`, which retains the eight-character minimum that this change raises for signup. — Users can set passwords through the invite flow that fall below the stated security minimum. — Fix: Update the minimum at `app/invite.py:1` and extend `tests/test_invite.py::test_password_boundaries`.
